text:
Alex: Quick check — eventing bridge smokecheck before analytics rollout tomorrow AM. Who can own the end-to-end run and verify mapping between event fields and cost attribution? @Sam @Jordan please weigh in.

Sam: I can take smokecheck ownership for the bridge. Blocker: data-mapping PR needs merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4823
Run locally: ```./scripts/smoke_check --source bridge-staging --limit 1000``` I'll queue it after merge.

Jordan: I'll own schema gating. Event schema PR 4831 has the field rename (user_id -> account_id) that causes downstream mismatch. Sample event:
```json
{"event":"generate","account_id":"acct_123","model":"rwd-1"}
```
We should add a compatibility shim in consumers.

Li: Heads-up — metrics pipeline has ~3m lag on staging right now. For the smokecheck you can run against snapshot data:
```bash
curl -sS https://staging-data-cache/redwood/snapshots/bridge-2026-03-16 | ./scripts/smoke_check --stdin
```
That avoids waiting for fresh events.

Maria: From analytics — need confirmation that attribution column `compute_cost_usd` is present and uses the new token-cost mapping. If not, our cost dashboards will be wrong. Please add me to rollback policy and tag the dashboard here: https://grafana.redwood/s/dashboards/costs

CI-bot: Canary build rwd-bridge-2026-03-16 passed all smoke tests :white_check_mark: (build 8921)

Alex: Owners summary:
- Schema gating: Jordan
- Bridge smoke test + merge: Sam
- Snapshot runner / pipeline workaround: Li
- Analytics / dashboards + rollback: Maria
Next steps: Sam merges mapping PR, Jordan will gate schema in staging, Li will run snapshot-based smokecheck, Maria will validate dashboards. I'll kick off canary at 09:00 PDT unless objections.

Sam: I'll merge after Li's quick review. pinging @Li :eyes:

Jordan: We need eng-infra to propagate schema changes to staging cluster (ticket INF-297). @eng-infra please ack.

Li: Ack, I'll review PR in 30m and be available during the 09:00 window.

Maria: I'll standby to validate dashboards immediately after smokecheck. SQL to sanity-check attribution:
```sql
SELECT account_id, SUM(compute_cost_usd) FROM events WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY SUM DESC LIMIT 10;
```

Alex: Thanks team — will post final canary start with links when ready :rocket:
